jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Solutions Engineer, US Enterprise - East Coast

Get to know Okta
Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.
At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.
Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Solutions Engineering Team

We believe Solutions Engineers at Okta are involved in all stages of the customer’s digital transformation. Solutions Engineers are experienced using presentations, email, phone and social media to connect with customers virtually and in-person. We are looking for great teammates who can build and deliver sales presentations and customized product demonstrations to help educate Okta’s Customers (everyone from developers to product managers to C-level executives) on best practices during their cloud security technology journey. We believe Okta’s Solutions Engineers empathize with Customers and quickly discern their true technical needs by asking detailed, clarifying questions while presenting solutions that specifically address those needs. Okta Solution Engineers have the rare combination of technical acumen and business insight; in a career where you can utilize both. As a Solutions Engineer at Okta, you will further develop each of these skills by advising a diverse set of customers on the value they will gain by using Okta’s Identity Platform.
The Solutions Engineer Opportunity
Reporting to the Senior Manager Solutions Engineering, Okta the Solutions Engineer is a functional business consultant, with a passion for technology and the advanced ability to develop, position and demonstrate product-specific solutions during sales cycles, while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.

What you’ll be doing

• Work alongside the sales team as the technical and domain expert of a customer-facing sales team to help Customers understand the value of Okta’s solutions

• Understand customer challenges and business issues and provide product demonstrations to align our solutions with customer needs

• Answer product feature and technical questions from customers, partners and Okta colleagues

• Plan and deliver Proof Of Concepts for customers who have more complex use cases, collaborating with other Okta engineering teams as needed

• Provide feedback to product management about product enhancements that can address customer needs and provide additional value

• Share and learn best practices and re-usable assets with other Solutions Engineers to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team

• Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation

• Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

• At times, be asked to learn and lead your team as a subject matter expert (SME) with various product solutions and/or competitive knowledge

What you’ll bring to the role

• 5+ years pre-sales engineering experience and solution selling.

• A passion to serve the Customer, demonstrated in a customer-facing role, such as presales or professional services, but ideally in a pre-sales capacity.

• An ability to quickly communicate complex ideas around a technical topic, ideally on the fly, using a whiteboard.

• Deployed apps in cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP, Vercel, etc.

• Experience with at least one standard network security protocol. (eg. OAuth, OAuth2, SAML, LDAP)

• Experience working with REST APIs and SDKs

• Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: web (JavaScript, HTML, frontend frameworks) development, backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python) development, scripting (Bash, Powershell, Perl)

• An understanding of core security concerns within a typical application. (password hashing, SSL/TLS, encryption at rest, XSS, XSRF)

• You're an exceptional communicator, adept at simplifying complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, including highly skilled experts in large group settings.

• A confident and articulate presenter, you excel at sharing knowledge and insights with experienced technical professionals and large expert audiences.

• Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex technical information to highly skilled and experienced audiences, whether one-on-one or in large presentations.

• Territory management skills, including pipeline building and working with Sales counterparts to guide execution excellence

• Diagramming experience for user journey flows, complex architecture diagrams, etc.

• Typically 25% travel.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS or equivalent experience

You ideally have

• Proven experience designing, implementing, and managing Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions in enterprise environments.

• Deep understanding of the challenges and best practices associated with securing privileged accounts, including just-in-time (JIT) access, session recording, credential vaulting, and secrets management.

• Practical experience managing Windows Server, Active Directory, LDAP, and Federation services.

• Proficiency in UNIX/Linux, database security, network security, scripting, and DevOps practices preferred.

• Relevant experience with enterprise applications, security management, systems management, identity management, and/or policy management solutions, particularly in the areas of Identity and Privileged Access

jobs.title: Specialist Solutions Architect, Billing
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

What you’ll do
You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities.
The team is looking for a Revenue and Finance Automation specialist with a deep understanding of the order-to-cash process and how modern businesses manage subscription billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition. You will engage with customers as a thought leader in the billing infrastructure space, helping them design solutions on Stripe Billing that reduce churn, improve cash collection, and align their financial operations with accurate revenue recognition under GAAP/IFRS standards.

Responsibilities

• Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Billing, Invoicing, and Revenue Recognition products to accelerate opportunities

• Demonstrate a deep understanding of the order-to-cash process—including subscription and usage-based billing, dunning, proration, and revenue recognition workflows—and how these map to Stripe's platform

• Conduct deep discovery of customers' existing billing architecture and business model to architect solutions that align Stripe's capabilities with their quote-to-cash requirements

• Advise customers on how to design for complexity: mid-cycle upgrades, entitlement management, multi-currency revenue recognition, and integration with ERP systems (NetSuite, Workday, SAP)

• Create and share best practices and reusable assets such as reference architectures to enhance the quality and efficiency of the broader sales and pre-sales organizations

• Partner closely with the Billing product sales team and actively drive opportunities for Stripe's largest customers, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships

• Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" to drive product and feature request prioritization

• Identify product, industry, implementation, and competitive trends, and provide actionable insights to product stakeholders and sales to influence Stripe's billing product roadmap

• Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team

• Represent the technical health of the business on quarterly sales forecast calls and highlight deal blockers with proposed solutions

• Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of experience in a technical sales, pre-sales, or solutions architecture role, with a focus on billing, subscription, or revenue management platforms

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with the order-to-cash process in a SaaS environment, including subscription lifecycle management, dunning, and revenue recognition

• Strong understanding of revenue recognition standards (ASC 606, IFRS 15) and how they apply to SaaS and usage-based business models

• Experience working with or implementing billing and ERP software (NetSuite, Workday, SAP, Zuora, BillingPlatform, or similar)

• Strong knowledge of software engineering and API integration patterns

• Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners

• Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

Preferred qualifications

• Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications

• Familiarity with complex billing scenarios: usage-based pricing, tiered models, multi-entity revenue recognition, or hybrid subscription and consumption models

• Experience with CRM platforms and their integration with billing systems

• Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

Staff Software Engineer, Customer Administration
The Customer Administration Engineering (CAE) team is a core pillar of Coinbase's Enterprise Applications and Architecture (EAA) org, responsible for building and operating the secure, foundational platforms that power customer data operations across Coinbase. Our flagship product, Control Center, is Coinbase's secure system of action for internal specialists across CX, Compliance, Legal, Global Investigations, Trust and Risk, and dozens of other teams. It serves approximately 7,000 internal users via its UI and powers a growing ecosystem of internal tools and AI automation via its backend APIs and MCP. We are at an exciting inflection point: evolving Control Center from a human-specialist UI into a modular, AI-agent-ready operations platform. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical anchor for the CAE team, driving architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and leading the delivery of high-impact, cross-cutting platform capabilities.
What You'll Do

• Architect and deliver foundational platform capabilities including MCP tool registries, AI orchestration layers, risk-based access automation, and the away-team contribution model that enables product groups across Coinbase to build on the platform safely and at speed

• Drive the evolution of Control Center into an AI-agent-ready, headless operations platform, designing and implementing MCP procedure constructs, agentic guardrails, HITL orchestration, and evaluation frameworks that enable both human and autonomous AI agents to execute sensitive customer operations securely

• Partner with the Engineering Manager and Product counterparts to define architectural roadmaps, author TDDs, lead design reviews, decompose complex initiatives into deliverable milestones, and raise the engineering quality bar through code review and mentorship

• Build and maintain highly reliable, secure, distributed backend services, owning SLO definitions, observability instrumentation, incident response, and operational readiness for Tier-1 platform systems

• Collaborate across EAA engineering teams, Product Engineering, and Security Engineering to deliver cross-functional outcomes and drive shared platform primitives that eliminate duplicated infrastructure across the portfolio

Required Skills and Experience

• 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of architecting and delivering large-scale, high-traffic distributed systems in production, including deep proficiency in backend service design, API development (gRPC, MCP, GraphQL), and scalable microservices architectures

• Proven ability to independently lead ambiguous, high-impact technical initiatives from whiteboard to production, writing high-quality, well-tested code and setting the standard for others across complex, multi-team problem spaces

• Strong experience with cloud-native infrastructure and the modern backend stack: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, BuildKite/CircleCI, event-driven architectures (Kafka, MQ), distributed caching (Redis/Memcached), and proficiency in SQL and/or NoSQL databases

• Track record of building secure, compliant internal tools or platforms, with deep appreciation for security controls, access management, audit logging, data governance, and engineering rigor in a regulated financial services environment

• Experience building or integrating with agentic AI systems, including MCP servers, LLM orchestration layers, RAG pipelines, HITL workflows, or evaluation and guardrail frameworks for production agentic workloads

• Proficiency in Go (Golang) as a primary backend language, with willingness to work across Python where applicable in the evolving AI stack

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

How do we work?
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

jobs.description:
Who we are:
Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.
Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:
As a Senior Project Manager on the Transformation & Project Management team, you will lead complex, cross-functional strategic projects that directly support our GTM teams including Professional Installation, Customer Implementation, Trial Success, Sales Engineering, Sales & Account Management teams. You will be responsible for turning strategy into execution across programs that span process, policy, data, and technology.
You will manage a portfolio of initiatives that drive critical improvements across processes, workflows, systems, tools, which enhance customer experience, enable scalability, and improve operational efficiencies.
This role is highly visible and requires frequent interaction with senior leaders across Operations, Product, Sales, Order Management, Customer Support, Finance, and IT.
We are looking for a seasoned Senior Project Manager who can operate at both strategic and tactical levels: framing problems, defining success metrics, setting up governance and operating rhythms, and driving successful projects through to measurable results and calculated impact.
What You’ll Do:
Program & Project Leadership

• Own and lead a portfolio of mid- to large-scale, cross-functional projects supporting GTM teams from discovery, deployment and impact measurement.

• Develop and maintain project artifacts including project charters, detailed project plans, action items, risk & mitigation plans, RACI, and weekly status updates that keep stakeholders aligned and accountable.

• Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, critical path, and success metrics in partnership with business stakeholders and functional leaders.

• Manage timelines, budgets, and resources across multiple concurrent projects, proactively addressing variances to keep initiatives on schedule and within budget.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with leaders across GTM teams to understand operational pain points, define future-state processes, and prioritize initiatives that drive scalability, quality, and profitability.

• Drive end-to-end readiness for new or enhanced workflows and systems by coordinating with Product, Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Order Management, Customer Support, Finance, Customer Success, and IT

• Facilitate effective decision-making through structured governance, clear mitigation planning, data based decision making and providing concise executive-ready updates.

Execution, Risk & Change Management

• Identify, manage, and mitigate risks, issues, and dependencies across teams and systems; ensure clear owners, due dates, and resolution paths.

• Implement and refine project management frameworks appropriate to each initiative and ensure consistent application of best practices.

• Lead change management for Implementation and Installation programs, including impact assessments, ROI, business justifications, communications, training and enablement plans, and adoption tracking.

• Ensure supporting project documentation, SOPs, and playbooks are comprehensive, current, and easily consumable by operational teams.

Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

• Use tools such as Salesforce, and other BI/reporting platforms to size problems, establish baselines, monitor KPIs, and track realized benefits with measurable impact

• Provide clear, data-backed status and performance reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership, highlighting progress, risks, and recommended actions.

• Conduct project retrospectives and leverage insights to improve project intake, prioritization, planning, and execution standards across the GTM organization.

• Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to improve project-management efficiency, ranging from project intake, prioritization, project-planning, measuring impact, identifying risks and dependencies, tracking action items, providing weekly updates, and capturing reusable project knowledge while applying appropriate human oversight and data-governance practices.

Leadership & Coaching

• Model best-in-class project management practices and mentor other Project Managers and project leads on methodology, communication, stakeholder management, and risk management.

• Contribute to the evolution of GTM Operations, Transformation & Strategy standards, templates, tooling, and training to raise delivery quality and consistency across the Project Management portfolio.

What We’re Looking For:

• 4+ years of project management experience working on Business facing, strategic cross functional initiatives with a proven track record of leading complex initiatives from discovery through execution.

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification required

• Background in process improvement or operational excellence (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) and comfortable designing and implementing new workflows

• Experience introducing or scaling project portfolio management practices, including intake, prioritization, and capacity planning.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and portfolios, balancing scope, schedule, resources, and quality while delivering against defined success metrics.

• Exceptional organizational and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience presenting to and influencing senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

• Deep familiarity with project management methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar) and comfort establishing governance, cadences, and working agreements.

• Data-driven mindset with hands-on experience using BI tools, AI tools etc. to analyze trends, build dashboards, and support decision-making.

• Proven experience in risk management and mitigation planning, including dependency mapping and contingency planning for multi-team initiatives.

• High degree of ownership, accountability, and follow-through, with the ability to drive clarity in ambiguous environments and keep projects moving forward.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in fleet management, telematics, logistics, field service management, or other hardware/software deployment environments.

• Experience applying AI and automation to streamline project-management processes, reduce manual work, improve decision-making, and increase delivery visibility.

job.title: Technical Logistics Coordinator
job.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel , we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.
Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel , contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
The Technical Logistics Coordinator within PM&D is coordinating and conducting a wide variety of technical tasks in collaboration with other CTS&L personnel, ensuring that projects are progressing, and systems and documents are set up and maintained according to quality standards, Standard Operating Procedures and applicable ICH-GxP* and other applicable local regulation and industry guidelines.
Depending on departmental needs and personal capabilities, the Technical Logistics Coordinator contributes to CTS&L system development (IT projects) as well as to process and SOP enhancements and the resolution of quality issues.

About the Role
We are seeking a Technical Logistics Coordinator (Clinical Trial Supplies and Logistics Technical Coordinator) to join our team in a Remote capacity, based in India . As a Technical Logistics Coordinator, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in study execution, system quality, regulatory compliance, and clinical data accuracy. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to clinical trial supply and logistics systems from project set-up through closure.
Clinical trial supply and logistics systems are essential to getting the right materials to the right sites at the right time. Your work directly supports the timely delivery of new therapies to patients. Responsibilities include coordinating and performing technical set-up of clinical trial supplies and logistics (CTS&L) systems, supporting system development, validation, and integration, and creating laboratory logistics documents and data transfers, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence study outcomes.
You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through system development, process and standard operating procedure (SOP) enhancements, and quality issue resolution. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Technical Logistics Coordinator can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.

Key Responsibilities

• Coordinate and perform timely, efficient technical set-up of CTS&L systems at project level, including project-specific documentation.

• Create system configuration documents and perform high-quality system setup within the project and program context, with quality checks and corresponding documentation.

• Perform required technical tasks during project conduct and closure, including laboratory data management, query resolution, and troubleshooting within the systems.

• Contribute to IT system developments and upgrades, including validation through design, testing, and documentation.

• Generate specifications and coordinate the creation of laboratory logistics print documents, such as forms and labels, and work with print vendors to ensure timely delivery.

• Coordinate data transfer agreements, shipment lists, and report specifications with project teams and data management.

• Perform programming and validation tasks, such as scripts in SAS, R, SQL, or other languages, for data transfers, reports, and shipment manifests.

• Coordinate the integration of CTS&L systems with Parexel internal systems and external systems such as Interactive Response Technology (IxRS) and Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems.

• Contribute to client meetings and audits, representing the Technical Services team and supporting CTS&L project teams.

• Support the development of training materials for system and process training of CTS&L personnel.

• Ensure project timelines, budgets, and efficiencies are met for the systems used, including control of pass-through costs and management of scope changes.

• Take ownership of assigned quality improvement (QI) actions, including containment, corrective, and preventive actions, and drive timely resolution.

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

• Strengths in analytical thinking, attention to detail, and prioritizing a varied workload across multiple tasks.

• A good understanding of the regulatory framework for drug development and clinical trials.

• The ability to collaborate in multi-disciplinary and matrix teams and to communicate clearly, both in writing and in speech.

• A self-motivated, professional attitude, a client-focused approach, and flexibility with new assignments and new learning.

• Comfort mastering the full functionality of a variety of computerized systems and applying it to achieve goals.

Required Qualifications

• Degree in Natural Sciences, Engineering, Informatics, Mathematics, or Statistics, or a vocational qualification (such as Technical Assistant or Documentation Assistant) with relevant working experience. Education as a Graphic Designer or Technical Publisher is also considered.

• Solid understanding of clinical supply chain management.

• Good knowledge of databases and the Windows operating system.

• Knowledge of International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Good Practice (GxP) guidelines, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes.

• Good English skills, with the ability to conduct business in English, both written and spoken, and in the local language if different from English.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous employment or appropriate expertise in engineering or technology within the pharmaceutical industry.

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

job.title: Technical Customer Support Specialist
job.description:
Headquarters: Japan
Technical Customer Support Specialist (Contract, Remote)
Who we are A global team united by curiosity and a shared mission: to be the first choice for AI audio. We're building a new category of technology from the ground up — moving fast, holding ourselves to a high bar, and giving everyone the autonomy to do their best work. The best idea wins, regardless of where it comes from.
About the role As a Technical Customer Support Specialist, you'll be on the front lines with our enterprise and B2B customers — helping them get the most out of ElevenLabs, including our API and the ElevenAgents platform, which orchestrates LLMs, telephony, and other AI integrations. You're not just resolving tickets; you're the person who understands what's actually going wrong, communicates it clearly, and helps make the product better because of it. This role requires someone who's proactive, technically sharp, and genuinely excited about where AI is going.
What you'll do

• Own enterprise support end-to-end — diagnose complex issues quickly, communicate clearly, and follow through until resolved

• Provide high-quality technical support in English

job.title: Developer Relations Engineer
job.description:
Headquarters: Remote (United States)
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!
About Tailscale
Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role
Tailscale is looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to own and improve the developer experience across Tailscale’s expanding product portfolio. You’ll help developers understand, adopt, extend, and build with our core VPN/connectivity product, while also shaping how that experience evolves as Tailscale expands into new product areas like secure AI access (Aperture), privileged access management (PAM), and whatever comes next.
You’re a builder, investigator, and storyteller. You write code, chase technical curiosities all the way down, and turn what you learn into things other developers can use like demos, docs, talks, blog posts, sample apps, workshops, videos, tools, and open source contributions. You build things, break things, explain things, and keep going until the thing you’re working on has a name.
You’re comfortable speaking at conferences and just as comfortable digging through an API, a GitHub issue, or a weird networking edge case until it makes sense. You’re probably the kind of person who runs a local AI model in your homelab and can explain exactly why. You ask “why does it work that way?” often, and your instinct is to make the answer clearer, simpler, and better for the next developer.

Requirements

• Strong software engineering fundamentals, with demonstrated experience building, debugging, and shipping real projects through professional work, open source, self-directed learning, or ambitious personal projects.

• Ability to create clear, useful developer-facing materials, including code samples, demos, tutorials, docs, blog posts, videos, talks, and workshops.

• Deep curiosity about how systems work, especially across networking, infrastructure, security, identity, cloud, open source, AI, or developer tooling.

• A track record of building and explaining technical systems, such as production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, homelabs, local AI setups, networking experiments, or open source contributions.

• Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly, creatively, and practically.

• Experience presenting to technical audiences, whether through conferences, meetups, livestreams, workshops, podcasts, videos, or internal engineering forums.

• Comfortable working in public through GitHub issues, pull requests, community forums, social channels, open source projects, and developer feedback loops.

• Strong developer empathy, emotional intelligence, and product sense; you notice friction, understand why it matters, and help translate it into better docs, APIs, examples, workflows, and product experiences.

• Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing, support, community, and other technical stakeholders while operating independently and driving high-impact projects from idea to execution.

• Comfortable managing multiple workstreams, meeting regular publishing, event, or launch deadlines, discussing technical tradeoffs in detail, and traveling for events, conferences, and community moments.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Go, networking, VPNs, WireGuard, identity, access controls, infrastructure automation, or security products.

• Experience building developer education programs, sample apps, workshops, technical video content, or conference talks.

• A visible history of technical writing, talks, demos, open source contributions, or community work.

• Experience with homelabs, self-hosting, local AI models, infrastructure experiments, or other “I wanted to understand how this works, so I built it” projects.

• Familiarity with secure AI access, privileged access management, zero trust, or modern infrastructure security patterns.

• Familiarity with open source contribution workflows and technical collaboration in public.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals, whether gained through formal education, professional experience, open source work, self-directed learning, or building ambitious projects on your own.

• A track record of building and explaining technical systems. This could include production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, open source contributions, homelab experiments, local AI setups, networking projects, or anything else that shows how you think.

• If your background is less conventional, we still want to hear from you. Bring us your GitHub repos, blog posts, diagrams, configs, talks, demos, lab notes, or the deeply specific story of why your homelab is built the way it is.

• Comfort discussing technical tradeoffs in detail such as explaining what you built, why you built it, what broke, what you learned, and what you would do differently next time.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.
US Pay Range
$127,000 — $141,000 USD

What We Offer

• An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.

• A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).

• Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!

• Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.

• Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.

• Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.

• Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.

• Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!

• A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.

• Paid parental leave program . We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness .

job.description:
Headquarters: US - Remote
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:
You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. As an Strategic Account Executive 7 at Wrike, you will play a critical role in landing & expanding key enterprise accounts. You’ll own the full sales cycle with new logos, expansion, engaging at C-suite/executive level, partnering with cross-functional teams, and demonstrating Wrike’s impact on enterprise transformation and ROI. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where your consultative approach and tenacity will directly unlock new business and deepen Wrike’s brand as a leader in the market.
If you’re a collaborative professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys connecting technology solutions to real business challenges, we want to hear from you!

Your Impact:

• Develop, manage, and close complex sales cycles; prospecting, leading discovery, presenting business cases, negotiating contracts, and landing new logos at the enterprise level (10,000+ employees).

• Deliver compelling presentations and business cases to executive audiences, demonstrating strategic thinking, business acumen, and exceptional consultative communication skills.

• Provide highly accurate and insight-driven monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline forecasts, and maintain meticulous CRM (Salesforce) hygiene.

• Serve as an expert consultant on digital and operational transformation; drive opportunities to upsell, cross-sell, and expand engagement within enterprise accounts.

• Proactively lead and coordinate cross-functional account teams—including Marketing, Sales Development, Solution Consultants, Legal, Security, and Implementation—to deliver a world-class enterprise client experience.

• Skillfully navigate complex legal, procurement, compliance, and security processes in collaboration with internal teams and enterprise client stakeholders.

• Stay at the forefront of SaaS trends and industry best practices to be a valued advisor to your clients and the broader Wrike team.

• Guide enterprise buyers through organizational change management and adoption planning, ensuring alignment, education, and readiness across large buying groups.

• Ensure a seamless and comprehensive handoff to Customer Success and Implementation teams, clearly documenting goals, expectations, and key learnings for ongoing client engagement.

• Regularly capture and communicate enterprise customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market feedback to Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership for continuous improvement.

• Mentor and support development of junior account executives, sharing best practices and contributing to team enablement initiatives.

Your Qualifications:

• Fluent in English (verbal and written)

• 5+ years of successful full-cycle SaaS sales experience, including enterprise-level new business acquisition (large deal sizes, multiple stakeholders)

• Demonstrated success executing complex deals with Fortune 1000/Global 5000 organizations and C-suite stakeholders

• Skilled in delivering consultative, solution-based sales cycles using methodologies like MEDDIC, Challenger, or Question-Based Selling

• Outstanding executive presence, business acumen, and ability to translate technical value into compelling ROI/value stories tailored to customer needs

• Proven ability to manage multiple sales processes and large pipelines, with consistent attainment or overachievement of quotas

• Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills; comfortable leading high-stakes executive meetings and product demos

• Experience managing legal, procurement, and information security processes for large enterprise agreements

• Proficiency with Salesforce and the modern SaaS sales tech stack

Standout Qualities:

• Experience in work management, project management, or a track record of selling to our ideal customer profiles (ICPs) in Marketing, Professional Services, Manufacturing or Engineering

• Additional language proficiency (if relevant to the territory)

Team Dynamics:
You’ll join Wrike’s high-performing New Business team, where your primary focus will be acquiring new enterprise customers and driving revenue growth. As a key member of our enterprise sales organization, you’ll play a critical role in expanding Wrike’s presence by landing new logos, shaping our go-to-market strategy, and fueling our continued growth in the enterprise segment.

Our Work Style:

• Collaborative Culture: Work alongside ambitious, supportive colleagues who celebrate wins together

• Comprehensive Training: Structured onboarding and ongoing sales enablement to help you master our product and refine your skills

• Work Flexibility: Options for remote work with the support you need to succeed from your home or the office

• Competitive Compensation: Base salary plus uncapped commission structure that rewards performance

Benefits & Perks:

• Flexible Time Off (FTO)

• Company 401(k) Match

• Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity

• 2 Volunteer Days

• Health Insurance (Employees + Dependents)

• Disability (STD, LTD) & Life Insurance Plans

• Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly)

• $500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Creative
We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.
Committed
We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

job.description:
Headquarters: Remote Eastern Canada | Remote Eastern United States
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.
Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.
The Role
BeyondTrust is looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to lead one of our core enterprise security product portfolios. You will own engineering for the portfolio end to end: technical direction, delivery, quality, and the people and leaders who make it happen.
Our products protect privileged access for enterprises around the world and are deployed on-premises, as appliances, and as SaaS. We are looking for a leader who can serve a demanding enterprise customer base today while moving the portfolio forward on modern cloud architecture and AI-driven engineering.
This is a senior, high-autonomy role. You will be expected to set direction, make and own significant technical and business decisions, and represent engineering with executives, product leadership, and customers.
What You’ll Do
Lead the Portfolio:

• Set the engineering strategy and technical vision for a portfolio of enterprise security products

• Guide cloud architecture for the portfolio's SaaS offerings on AWS, with security, reliability, and scale built in

• Balance investment across deployment models so every customer segment is well served

• Partner with peer engineering leaders on shared services and common architecture

Make Engineering AI-Native:

• Lead the adoption of AI-assisted and agentic development across the organization, from design and coding through testing and release

• Set the standards, tooling, and expectations that make AI a normal part of how teams work, and measure the impact

• Bring AI into quality engineering and operational workflows, not just code generation

Deliver with Quality:

• Own release quality and predictability across all deployment models

• Champion modern quality engineering: test automation, continuous testing, and quality built into the pipeline

• Ensure reliable, secure delivery of releases and updates to customers

• Partner with Support and customer-facing teams on sustaining engineering and high-impact customer issues

Build Security into Delivery:

• Own engineering's side of vulnerability response, from triage through fix to timely patch delivery

• Partner with the security organization on threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing, and make sure findings turn into fixes

• Treat security as a core product quality, held to the same standard as reliability and performance

Build the Organization:

• Lead a multi-team organization of software engineers, quality engineers, and managers through directors and senior managers

• Hire, develop, and retain a strong leadership bench

• Establish planning and execution rhythms that give the business clear visibility into progress and risk

• Own the engineering budget, headcount plan, and vendor and tooling decisions for the portfolio

Partner Across the Business:

• Serve as the primary engineering counterpart to Product Management, owning feasibility and cost on roadmap commitments

• Communicate clearly and proactively with executive leadership

What You’ll Bring

• 12+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years leading multi-team organizations through managers and directors

• A track record of delivering enterprise software with a large installed base, ideally spanning on-premises and SaaS

• A background in secure software development: you have built and shipped security-sensitive software, worked closely with security teams on threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing, and led engineering's side of vulnerability response through fix and patch

• Strong AWS fluency: you have led engineering for products running on AWS and can engage credibly on architecture, security, and cost

• Hands-on conviction about AI in software engineering: you use AI tools yourself and have led their adoption across teams with measurable results

• Experience with modern SaaS engineering practice: multi-tenant architecture, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability

• Experience leading quality engineering toward automation and continuous testing

• Sound financial and vendor judgment, including build-vs-buy decisions and budget ownership

• Excellent written and verbal communication with executives, peers, and customers

Nice To Have

• Identity or privileged access management domain experience

• Experience leading teams building enterprise applications on .NET (C#)

• Experience with regulated cloud environments (FedRAMP, StateRAMP, or similar)

• Experience delivering AI-powered product capabilities

• Experience leading distributed teams across countries and time zones

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience; Master's a plus

Better Together
Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.
We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.
About Us
BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.
BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.
Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com .

About the Opportunity
OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions.

Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out.

You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.

• Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.

• Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release.

• Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision.

• Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers.

• Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product.

• Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team.

• Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee.

• Hands-on leader. Build a small, senior team, scaled through the reporting vendor and outside advisers. Coordinate with and train local compliance and entity leads.

• Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support tax authority examinations with complete, reproducible records.

What We Look For In You

• 7+ years in tax information reporting, tax operations, or regulatory data reporting at a global exchange, broker, bank, fintech, or digital asset platform, including at least 3 years leading a team.

• Hands-on experience in a global, distributed digital asset business: you have worked with exchange or wallet transaction data, multiple legal entities, and users spread across many jurisdictions. This is required.

• Strong data skills. You can write SQL, define data specifications for engineers, reconcile large transaction datasets to a ledger, and find the gap when the numbers do not tie. You have built or run data quality controls on reporting output.

• Working knowledge of CARF, DAC8, CRS, and FATCA, including due diligence rules, self-certification requirements, reportable transaction categories, and the XML schemas used for exchange. Direct CARF or DAC8 implementation experience is strongly preferred given live DAC8 obligations and upcoming CARF reporting.

• Experience managing a tax reporting vendor or reporting platform, including scoping, testing, and holding the vendor to a delivery calendar. the tax platform vendor experience is a plus.

• Experience building a function from a small base: writing the policy, designing the controls, hiring the team, and running the first cycle.

• Ability to explain data and tax issues plainly to executives, engineers, and local compliance officers, and to run a steering committee.

• Judgment on when to escalate, comfort working across US, EU, and Asia time zones, and a record of meeting hard filing deadlines.

Nice to Haves

• Experience with US Form 1099-DA or 1099-B production, backup withholding, or Qualified Intermediary reporting.

• Experience with the DAC8 60-day account restriction process or equivalent undocumented account remediation at scale.

• Familiarity with GDPR requirements for sharing customer data with tax authorities, including data protection impact assessments.

• Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks.

• Experience working inside a Three Lines Model, including supporting second-line monitoring and Internal Audit.

• A CPA, chartered tax adviser, or equivalent; or a degree in data science, computer science, or accounting.

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

• Various team building programs and company events

• More that we love to tell you along the process!

As a Principal Engineer at Dropbox, you will own company critical, loosely defined technical problems with multi year impact, operating at the intersection of technology, product, business strategy, and applied AI. You will lead the responsible introduction and adoption of AI across product capabilities and engineering workflows, bring clarity to the most complex decisions, institutionalize engineering excellence, and contribute directly through critical design, prototyping, and code reviews.

In return, you will operate as a trusted technical partner to senior leadership, shape systems and platforms including AI powered foundations that define Dropbox’s future, and act as a company level technical strategist, advancing Dropbox’s mission to create a more enlightened way of working.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is looking for an experienced manager to lead SOX business process compliance and help keep the trust in our financial reporting as strong as the business we’re building. As part of our SOX Compliance team, you’ll help oversee and strengthen Samsara’s global control environment, protecting the accuracy of our financial reporting and keeping us compliant as we scale. You’ll partner closely with IT and business process owners to design and implement controls, spot gaps early, and drive remediation to the finish line. We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership. You bring deep, hands-on SOX expertise, a track record of delivering projects reliably, and the confidence to run with complex work independently. If you take pride in being the person others count on to get it done right, we’d love to meet you.
This is a remote position open to candidates based in Canada.
You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Develop, lead, and execute periodic financial risk assessments, materiality calculations, and scoping of the SOX program

• Develop and deliver training to SOX control owners, including process documentation, testing methodology, management review controls, and controls over Information Produced by the Entity (IPE).

• Conduct walkthroughs across all business process areas and work with business process owners to ensure timely review and updates to the control documentation

• Collaborate cross functionally to design leading edge practices with a financial compliance mindset across several complex business process areas.

• Monitor and assess emerging financial reporting risks with the growth and evolution of the business and develop plans to implement appropriate controls to timely address these emerging risks

• Ownership of control deficiency evaluation, aggregation analysis as well as development and execution of related remediation plans.

• Help drive the SOX AI transformation strategy by identifying high-value opportunities, implementing AI-enabled solutions, and driving adoption and new ways of working across the global SOX organization.

• Provide reporting to business leaders on program status, health, and effectiveness of the business process control environment

• Collaborate and align with the company’s external audit and internal audit around financial reporting risks, design of ICFR monitoring systems,and SOX program approach

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

• 7+ years of SOX 404 / ICFR experience at a Big Four (internal or external audit) or combination of Big Four and public company experience

• Hands-on experience with risk assessment, scoping, walkthroughs, control design, and deficiency evaluation

• Strong knowledge of order to cash, procure to pay, financial close and reporting controls

• Ability to identify, assess and explain risks and control gaps clearly to executives and other non-technical audiences

• Working knowledge of COSO 2013, PCAOB AS 2201, and SEC ICFR guidance, including management review controls and IPE

• Bachelor's in accounting or finance (CPA and/or CIA preferred)

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience with financial systems such as Netsuite, Salesforce, Workday and Xactly

• Experience using automation or AI tools to make compliance work faster, more reliable, and SOX compliant

• Experience working closely with Internal Audit and External Auditors

• Strong communication skills, including presenting to and influencing senior business leaders

• Demonstrated success managing worksteams/project independently

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

At Affirm, we’re reimagining how people access and experience financial products. Our commitment to clarity, honesty, and empathy fuels every design decision across all of our user experiences. We’re looking for a Content Designer II to help create clear, useful, trustworthy, and compelling product experiences that make it easier for people to understand and use Affirm.

About the team
In this role, you’ll work as an embedded partner on a product team, collaborating closely with Product Design, Research, Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Legal, Compliance, and Customer Experience. You’ll help design and improve product experiences from discovery through launch, experimentation, and optimization, with a focus on both thoughtful content strategy and precise UX writing.
You’ll bring strong writing skills, customer empathy, and product thinking to important product work. You’ll ask thoughtful questions, explain your rationale clearly, and advocate for simple, transparent experiences that help customers make informed decisions. You’ll use content strategy, systems thinking, and UX writing to help teams create experiences that are simple, transparent, and customer-centered.
You’ll also contribute to Affirm’s growing Content Design practice by sharing feedback, participating in team rituals, helping strengthen guidelines and patterns, and partnering with other content designers. This role is ideal for a collaborative, curious, and customer-oriented content designer who is ready to grow their craft while making meaningful contributions to product experiences.

What You’ll Do

• Contribute content design to product work, shaping user flows, information architecture, content hierarchy, UX writing, and customer communications across web and native app experiences.

• Work cross-functionally with Product Design, Research, Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Legal, Compliance, and Customer Experience from early ideas through launch and optimization.

• Help teams understand customer problems, identify content and usability opportunities, and make thoughtful decisions about how product experiences should work and communicate.

• Write clear, accurate, concise, and human product content across in-product flows, notifications, emails, text messages, prototypes, and other customer touchpoints.

• Use research, experimentation, customer feedback, and data to improve content decisions, usability, and customer understanding.

• Participate in design sprints, critique, content reviews, and product discussions as an advocate for clarity, accessibility, and content-first design.

• Help strengthen Affirm’s content design practice by contributing to style guides, writing guidelines, reusable patterns, team artifacts, and shared ways of working.

What We Look For

• 2+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, content strategy, information architecture, or a related field, with experience designing for web and native digital products.

• A portfolio that shows strong UX writing craft, strategic thinking, and shipped product experiences across in-app, web, or other customer touchpoints.

• Strong understanding of UX writing, information architecture, content hierarchy, usability, accessibility, research, experimentation, and product development.

• Ability to work independently on defined projects, navigate ambiguity with support, connect content decisions to customer needs and business goals, and move work forward with care.

• Experience collaborating with PMs, designers, researchers, engineers, legal, compliance, marketing, or brand partners to shape clear and effective product experiences.

• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain rationale, invite feedback, build alignment, and advocate for the customer.

• Nice to have: experience in financial services, regulated industries, native app experiences, design systems, lifecycle communications, or AI-enabled content workflows.

job.title: Creative Engineer, Stripe Creative Lab
job.description:
Headquarters: New York, US, Canada, Remote

Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Brand Studio team works on a variety of brand-centric projects for Stripe, from our brand standards to campaigns, events, IRL experiences, packaging, digital products, and even printed publications. The brand designers on this team are multidisciplinary in nature, able to design robust visual systems, art direction, and craft surfaces that focus on brand and product storytelling.
Collaborating with other teams at Stripe, as well as external partners, we raise the quality and consistency of experiences with the Stripe brand IRL, virtually, and everywhere in between. We craft the creative vision and strategy for different types of projects and audiences, and amplify them across various mediums, channels, objects to environments, and digital and physical experiences.
About Stripe Creative Lab
Stripe Creative Lab aims to create breakthrough, culturally resonant, and exquisitely crafted projects that reveal Stripe’s magic in surprising ways. We dedicate ourselves to meticulously crafting the work to ensure the highest possible creative quality. The work is experimental, often starts with ambiguous briefs and requires finding a way where others might deem it impossible. We are making it up as we go, and that’s the way we love to work.

What you’ll do

You’ll be joining a highly creative team working across digital experiences, interactive projects, physical installations, experimental technology, and whatever else an idea might require. The work often begins without an obvious technical solution and sometimes without knowing exactly what form the final project should take.
As a Design Engineer, you’ll work closely with designers, art directors, and producers to figure out what’s possible, prototype ideas quickly, and turn ambitious creative concepts into working experiences. You’ll bring deep technical expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, alongside the curiosity and technical range to work confidently beyond it.
A significant amount of our work lives on the internet, so you should be comfortable independently building and shipping highly crafted digital experiences. Other projects may involve hardware, physical computing, unusual displays, installations, or technical systems we haven’t encountered before. You won’t be expected to be an expert in everything, but you should be excited to learn, experiment, and know when to bring in specialists.

Responsibilities

• Prototype and build highly crafted, experimental digital experiences, interactive projects, and creative tools

• Work closely with designers and art directors to translate ambitious creative direction into technically excellent experiences, while contributing your own judgment to make the work better

• Explore emerging technologies and unfamiliar technical approaches, quickly determining what is possible and how best to build it

• Independently navigate ambiguous technical problems, moving pragmatically from early experiments to finished work

• Build and publish standalone web experiences when appropriate, while identifying and communicating the additional engineering support required for more complex projects

• Experiment with hardware, physical computing, displays, sensors, embedded systems, and other technologies when projects call for them

• Collaborate with external engineers, fabricators, technical studios, and other specialists, contributing enough technical fluency to be an effective creative and engineering partner

• Maintain a high bar for performance, reliability, usability, and craft without allowing conventional technical approaches to unnecessarily constrain an idea

Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 6+ years of relevant software engineering, creative technology, or creative development experience

• Deep expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, with demonstrated curiosity and competence across adjacent technologies

• A portfolio of technically ambitious, highly crafted work such as experimental websites, interactive experiences, realtime graphics, games, installations, creative tools, or other unusual applications of technology

• Strong frontend engineering fundamentals and experience independently building and shipping public-facing web experiences

• Strong visual and interaction sensibility, with the ability to faithfully execute sophisticated creative direction and identify opportunities to improve it

• Experience solving unfamiliar technical problems with a high degree of independence

• Experience writing thoughtful, maintainable code and making pragmatic engineering decisions in fast-moving environments

Preferred qualifications
